blocks.text: Let's solve this one step by step. Two times the quantity x squared minus three x, minus x times the quantity x minus four, plus five.
Distribute. Two times the quantity x squared minus three x is two x squared minus six x. Negative x times the quantity x minus four is negative x squared plus four x.
The x squared terms: two x squared minus x squared is x squared.
The x terms: negative six x plus four x is negative two x. Five stays as it is.
So the answer is x squared minus two x plus five.

Watch out for these traps. If you make negative x times negative four negative, you get x squared minus ten x plus five. If you ignore the minus in front of x times the quantity, you get three x squared minus ten x plus five.
